name: Picotta
summary:
Picotta is a multiplayer farming game in pixel art, played in the web browser on phones and computers. Every player walks a farmer through a shared open world, sees other players live, and builds their own farm: placing fields, a barn, a chicken coop and a mill, then planting, watering and harvesting crops that grow in real time, even while the game is closed.

Beyond the fields, players raise chickens, cows and sheep, ride horses, fish in the lake valley, chop wood, mine ore in the mountain and cook what they gather. The town is the meeting point: players chat, make friends, trade with each other at the market counter, help the townsfolk with favors, get married in the chapel and run for mayor.
